skills.name: Composite - Cut an object on a particular location
skills.description: Determine the location to cut and cut the object using a cutting tool.

steps.activity: Determine the location to cut on the object_to_cut
Position the cutting_tool near the determined location on the object_to_cut
Cut the object_to_cut with the cutting_tool along the determined location

examples: Cut a wire at a selected location with pliers

skills.name: Composite - Cut something to measurement without marking
skills.description: Use a measuring tool to determine the location to cut on a piece of material and cut the material using a cutting tool.

steps.activity: Position the measuring_tool on the object_to_cut or position the object_to_cut along the measuring_tool
Take measurement to determine the cut location on the object_to_cut
Cut the object_to_cut with the cutting_tool along the mark
steps.category: Composite - Cut an object on a particular location

examples: Cut a shingle with a utility knife using another shingle as a guide

skills.name: Composite - Cut something to measurement with marking
skills.description: Use a measuring tool to mark a specific location of a piece of material and cut the material following the mark using a cutting tool.

steps.activity: Measure with measuring_tool and mark the cut location on the  object_to_cut
Cut the object_to_cut with the cutting_tool along the mark
steps.category: Composite - Cut an object on a particular location

examples: Cut roof flashing to length with a hacksaw

skills.name: Composite - Hold and cut something
skills.description: Hold an object on a surface with one hand and cut it with a cutting tool using the other hand.

steps.activity: Determine the position of the object_to_cut
Position the cutting tool near the determined position of the object_to_cut
Hold the object_to_cut with one hand
steps.category: Pull or push an object with arm

steps.activity: Cut the object_to_cut with the cutting_tool using the other hand

examples: Hold a pipe with one hand and cut it with a handsaw using the other hand
